other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Market Size & Segmentation Scenario Market Size & Growth Trend of Indian IT-BPM Sector The Indian IT-BPM industry has witnessed robust and sustained growth over the past several years, establishing itself as a global leader in technology and business process services.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Key Takeaways • BFSI and Other industry segments are the primary growth drivers, and market players, intending to expand their domestic presence are likely to prioritize solutions tailored to specific needs of the BFSI segment. • Focus on digital transformation for high revenue generation, is necessary to curb the strong appetite for digital services.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The country has witnessed the establishment of over 400 GCCs over this 5-year period, growing at a CAGR of almost 5% between FY 2019-24 translating in GCCs revenue growth to USD 64.6 bn from USD 40 bn, growing at a healthy CAGR of close to 10% over the 5 years.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Between FY2019 and FY2024, the number of GCCs in India surged to over 1,700, with more than 400 new entrants marking a CAGR of ~5%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The installed talent base in Indian GCCs crossed 1.9 million as of FY2024, growing at a CAGR of over 6%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The revenue generated by Indian GCCs climbed from USD 40+ billion in FY2019 to USD 64.6 billion by FY2024, registering a robust ~10% CAGR.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: According to the Data Security Council of India's (DSCI) India Cybersecurity Domestic Market 2023 report, the domestic cybersecurity market expanded from USD 1.98 billion in 2019 to USD 6.06 billion in 2023, reflecting a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of over 30%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Source: Invest India, NASSCOM The Indian SaaS industry is projected to grow at a strong CAGR of 18.3% between FY 2022 and FY 2030, expanding from USD 13 billion to USD 50 billion.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Currently, India’s telemedicine segment is valued at about $5.5 billion by FY 2025, while India’s telehealth sector is expected to grow with its major players like Practo, Mfine, Tata Health and Apollo Telehealth, at a CAGR of 20.75% to 2030.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The global remote patient monitoring market alone is estimated to grow at a CAGR of 12.7% and reach $56.94 billion by 2030.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Digital advertising is anticipated to grow at a CAGR of 13.5%, increasing from INR 662 billion in 2024 to INR 842 billion by 2026.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate) is marked at 4.7%, indicating a consistent pace of industry development.
